core_data_flows.name: Standard Rulebook → Substrates
core_data_flows.steps: Load rulebook.json | Dispatch to all injectors | Generate substrate code | Package artifacts
core_data_flows.triggers: User selects option A in orchestrator menu
core_data_flows.outputs: Generated code in each execution-substrates/{tech}/ folder

core_data_flows.name: Pull from Airtable
core_data_flows.steps: Call airtable-to-rulebook CLI | Write effortless-rulebook.json | Cache offline version
core_data_flows.triggers: User selects option P (Pull & Inject) or changes base via option B

core_data_flows.name: Conformance Testing
core_data_flows.steps: Load test cases YAML | Run each substrate's take-test.py | Collect outputs | Compare results | Generate report
core_data_flows.triggers: User selects option V (View Results) or automatic after injection

core_data_flows.name: Clean Generated Files
core_data_flows.steps: Delete all generated outputs in each execution-substrates/ folder
core_data_flows.outputs: Empty substrate directories ready for fresh injection

core_data_flows.name: Swap Ontologies (Hub Promotion)
core_data_flows.steps: User selects domain in effortless-rulebooks/ | Point orchestrator to domain's rulebook | Re-run injection & tests with new domain
core_data_flows.triggers: Rulebook hub promotion complete; becomes the primary SSoT instead of Airtable
core_data_flows.outputs: All substrates regenerated for new domain; conformance verified
